''See also: [[Albedon Pegarthus Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Albedon Pegarthus, also known as Albedon, is a [[Visiri man]] who serves as the current [[Champion]] of the [[Prime Arena]]. He possesses a large, imposing build with long limbs and is slightly taller and broader than Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion. Physically, he is characterized by a red scalp with very short white hair and prominent, heavy eyebrows. He is politically connected as the nephew of a powerful Senator. In combat, Albedon utilizes a specialized [[technique]] known as the [[Eraser Blade]], a highly efficient and lethal style designed to exert intense pressure on a single target. His equipment includes thick armor and a large [[force-blade]]. Although he has faced Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion in a duel—a match where Albedon eventually conceded defeat after pushing Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion to his limits—he has later accepted a challenge in the name of [[Senator Pegarthus]] and the planet [[Visiria]], displaying an aggressive intent to conclude combat quickly.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Albedon Pegarthus is characterized by white hair and a red scalp. He wields a large orange [[force-blade]] during combat.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|As the nephew of an influential Senator, he serves as a fighter representing his relative. He is currently the [[Champion]] of the [[Prime Arena]] and is noted to be a fighter who made a mistake.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|He utilizes the [[Eraser Blade]] [[Combat Art]]. His combat style involves the use of a large orange [[force-blade]].}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Albedon Pegarthus serves as the current [[Champion]] of the [[Prime Arena]]. As a fighter representing his influential uncle, [[Senator Pegarthus]], he wields an orange [[force-blade]] and utilizes the [[Eraser Blade]] [[Combat Art]]. This warrior is characterized by his white hair and a red scalp. Although he utilizes a large [[force-blade]] in combat, Albedon is a fighter who eventually made a mistake.}}
